- No changeset entry for `@object-ui/components`, because only a devDependency changes and nothing it ships changes. The existing changeset still covers `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` and `@objectstack/client`.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components test`: 455 test files passed and 1 was skipped. 4369 tests passed and 24 were skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`: exit 0.

- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 69 derived families. All of them ran after a full `pnpm build`, and all exited 0. `--ran` reconciles them: 69 run, 0 not measured, 0 unrun.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` tests: 448/448 passed. `@objectstack/client` tests: 680/680 passed.

**Corrections to the body, which cannot be edited through the relay**

The body still says `Part of`, so merging will not close the card by itself. The seat closes it after the next scheduled `Validate Dependencies` run, which is the card's final reading.
- **The `deepmerge` section** and its proposed `[[IgnoredVulns]]` entry are withdrawn. `osv-scanner.toml` keeps exactly one exemption, the existing `@azure/msal-node` GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 entry, unchanged (it expires 2026-11-26). The only ledger change in this PR is still the removal of the unused `GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c`.
